summary: Provider-internal records stored with the user role no longer show as user bubbles. A Claude slash-command record (<command-name>/<command-message>/<command-args>) reads as the `/name args` the user typed and merges with Switchboard's own copy of the send, so `/compact` shows once. The summary a /compact leaves (flagged isCompactSummary in the transcript) is one collapsed 'Conversation compacted' row that expands to the summary. Codex <user_instructions> and <external_codex_apps_open_page> bootstraps are dropped like the other injected context. Only blocks at the start of a message count; a message that mentions a tag mid-text is untouched.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing stored is rewritten: the transcript parser normalizes rows at load time and every surface splits at render time. A phone cache holding an old raw row is split by the phone's own splitter, which now knows the new blocks.

automated: tests/fixtures/synthetic-user-message-cases.json holds hand-written vectors (command records in both tag orders, with and without args, followed by stdout; empty stdout; stderr; caveat; compact summary; system-reminder; Codex AGENTS.md, user_instructions, environment_context, apps page, turn_aborted) plus real messages that mention a tag mid-text, an unterminated tag and typed continuation prose. tests/unit/synthetic-user-message-fixtures.test.ts and SyntheticUserMessageFixturesTest.kt run the same file against the TypeScript and Kotlin splits.

tests/unit/jsonl-parser.test.ts: a /compact record parses to '/compact' and merges with the SQLite copy into one row, the isCompactSummary record becomes one compacted part, and a typed message mentioning <command-name> is kept as typed.
apps/mobile jest: SyntheticRow shows 'Conversation compacted' collapsed and the summary on tap.
notExercised: No surface was driven by hand. The shapes were surveyed read-only from local Claude and Codex transcripts; the fixtures are fake.
Live path: the Claude adapter never renders SDK user messages, so the compact summary appears only once the transcript is reloaded, as before.
Codex compaction writes a `compacted` line, not a user message, so it neither leaked nor gets a row.
